title: Fixed-Point Reasoners: Stable and Adaptive Deep Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2606.18206v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Looped architectures provide an inductive bias toward learning step-by-step procedures for tasks that require compositional reasoning. Increasing the effective layers of looped architectures can improve their reasoning capabilities. Similar to deep architectures, looped architectures are prone to a signal propagation problem induced by depth as the halting decision is postponed. In this paper, we address the signal propagation issue by using pre-norm layers and residual scaling. By improving signal propagation, we achieve competitive performance without hierarchical looping, resulting in a simpler architecture than previous state-of-the-art models evaluated on puzzle reasoning tasks. Building on these modifications, we propose FPRM: a Transformer-based Fixed-Point Reasoning Model that uses fixed-point convergence as an end-to-end halting mechanism in a looped architecture. translated_title: 不动点推理器：稳定且自适应的深度循环Transformer
translated_abstract: 循环架构为需要组合推理的任务提供了学习逐步求解过程的归纳偏置。增加循环架构的有效层数可以提升其推理能力。与深层架构类似，随着停止决策被推迟，循环架构也容易出现由深度引起的信号传播问题。在本文中，我们通过使用预归一化层和残差缩放来解决信号传播问题。通过改善信号传播，我们在不使用分层循环的情况下取得了有竞争力的性能，从而得到了一个比之前在谜题推理任务上评估的最先进模型更简单的架构。基于这些改进，我们提出了FPRM：一个基于Transformer的不动点推理模型，它在循环架构中使用不动点收敛作为端到端的停止机制。我们表明，不动点停止机制使FPRM能够自适应地调整其计算……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文通过预归一化层和残差缩放解决深度循环Transformer的信号传播问题，并提出以不动点收敛作为端到端停止机制的FPRM模型，使模型能根据问题难度自适应地调整推理深度。
en_tdlr: This paper tackles signal propagation issues in deep looped Transformers via pre-norm layers and residual scaling, and proposes FPRM, which uses fixed-point convergence as an end-to-end halting mechanism to adaptively adjust reasoning depth.
